$description: Appearance-invariant base tokens and WinUI 3 style overrides (Segoe UI Variable, Consolas, double focus rings, timing motion).

designMd.overview: WinUI 3 (`winui3/release/2.7.0`): Windows 11 fill and stroke resources composited over `SolidBackgroundFillColorBase` (`#F3F3F3` light / `#202020` dark) with `#0078D4` accent, `Segoe UI Variable` + `Consolas`, double focus strokes, and deterministic timing curves.
designMd.elevation: WinUI 3 ThemeShadow depths (2/8/16/32/128) paired with composited `ControlStrokeColorDefault` / `SurfaceStrokeColorDefault` borders and `material.windows` blur on `glass`, `menu`, and `tooltip` (`AcrylicInAppFillColorDefault` 0.85 light / 0.96 dark).
dos: Use `4px` `ControlCornerRadius` for `control` and `8px` `OverlayCornerRadius` for `container` and `modal` with `shape.curve: "circular"`.
Use `focus.style: "double"` (2px outer `FocusStrokeColorOuter` + 1px inner `FocusStrokeColorInner`) and WinUI timing motion (`decelerate` / `point-to-point`).
Use `controls: "winui"` (underlined tabs/fields and leading navigation bar indicators) with `Segoe UI Variable` (`{font.family.sans}`).
donts: Do not substitute continuous squircle corners or spring physics for WinUI 3's circular corners and timing curves.

radius.$description: WinUI 3 corner radius scale: ControlCornerRadius 4px (control) and OverlayCornerRadius 8px (container and modal).

control.$description: Corner radius for in-page controls, fields, rows, chips, badges, wells, color areas, and kbd.

container.$description: Corner radius for cards, menus, popovers, tooltips, list panels, toasts, and frames.

modal.$description: Corner radius for dialogs, sheets, and drawers.

focus.$description: WinUI 3 double focus stroke (2px outer FocusStrokeColorOuter + 1px inner FocusStrokeColorInner, 0px offset).

width.$description: 2px outer focus stroke width per WinUI 3.

control.$description: WinUI 3 control dimensions: SelectorBar's bar, TextBox's box-underline, inset selection controls, a hairline track and a ring knob (docs/specs/theme-contract-v2.md §11.2).

sans.$description: WinUI 3 primary UI font stack (Segoe UI Variable, Segoe UI, sans-serif; typography.md).

typography.$description: WinUI 3 typography scale mapped from TextBlock_themeresources.xaml (400 and 600 weights only).

label.$description: Control labels, form labels, and interactive triggers.

shape.$description: Circular corner curve (WinUI 3 has no continuous squircle curve; geometry.md).

color.$description: Appearance-invariant C-layer color roles shared by light and dark modes.

scrim.$description: Translucent backdrop scrim behind modals and overlays (WinUI SmokeFillColorDefault #4D000000).

media.$description: Ground behind photographs and videos; invariant across appearances.

on-media.$description: White ink over photographs and dark media surfaces; invariant across appearances.

state.$description: Interaction state opacities, press scale, and ripple switch.

press-scale.$description: Scale factor applied while pressed (1 disables press shrinking; WinUI 3 swaps fill brushes instead).

pressed-opacity.$description: Content stays full opacity when pressed (1; fill brush swap shows press).

disabled.$description: WinUI 3 disabled styling: 0.36 TextFillColorDisabled content with fill: true container override.

enter.$description: WinUI 3 250ms entrance transition with Direct Entrance decelerate curve (motion.md).

motion.$description: Interactive spring and timing physics roles: fast, default, slow, and the state fade.

timing.$description: Timing curve and duration for fast.
Timing curve and duration for default.
Timing curve and duration for slow.
Timing curve and duration for state.
